title: filtri/1: the filters that hide rows of the feature table, in order, with the rows each one hid
description: The `filtri` key of the `interp` object in the meta of the `.mzfeat` (crates/mzlab-feat/src/interp/filtri.rs). A row is hidden by the first filter that applies; nothing is deleted and every hidden row keeps its id. English only.

stages.description: F1 Peak quality, F2 Same molecule (an isotopologue of another row), F3 Formed by the treatment, F4 Not an in-source fragment, F5 Mass error (against the per-file calibration, tolerance max(3 ppm, 2 MAD), at most 5 ppm)

hidden.description: number of rows this filter hid

why.description: the reason shown to the user

decoys.description: decoy deltas tried against the filters and how many survived (the estimate of false matches); null until the validation fills it
